description: Unaffordable healthcare is a serious issue in our district. A third of people's income is spent on healthcare, if they have insurance. Molly was 30 years old and had just been diagnosed with breast cancer. She had no insurance. The diagnosis alone cost $200,000 — before a single treatment. This is why I'm running for Congress. 🔗 LEARN MORE & GET INVOLVED X: @DrWitta Instagram: @Dr.Witta TikTok: @wittamd ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ABOUT DR. WITTA Dr. Samir Witta is an oncologist, NIH researcher, and independent candidate running for U.S. Congress in Colorado's 6th District (Aurora, Centennial, Greenwood Village). After 15 years running a cancer clinic in Aurora, Dr. Witta has seen firsthand how the broken healthcare system destroys families financially — even when they fight and survive the disease itself. He is running as an Independent — taking zero PAC money, zero corporate donations — with one mission: Respect. Reform. Restore.
title: One Visit. $200,000. She had no insurance. | Dr. Witta | News
